s40_unsupported_liquidation_pnl_claim: -5,000.00 USDT (Equating perp wipeout with total loss)
s40_liquidation_pnl_corrected_explanatio: LIQUIDATION ACCOUNTING CORRECTION: In Sprint 09.40, unsupported isolated margin liquidation scenarios reported a terminal net P&L of exactly -5,000 USDT. This was an erroneous simplification that equated perpetual margin wipeout with total portfolio loss. In reality, the Spot BTC position ($0.11825 BTC) remained open in the segregated Spot wallet. When the perpetual short was liquidated at BTC = 88,378 USDT, the Spot inventory was worth 10,450.63 USDT. Total portfolio equity at breach was +10,450.63 USDT. Post-liquidation, the portfolio held an unhedged +100% directional Spot position. Evaluated at horizon close (BTC = 84,349.94 USDT), total realizable equity was 9,968.33 USDT (Net P&L: -31.67 USDT, or -0.32% on 10k capital), or +444.36 USDT (+4.44%) if closed immediately at breach. The claim of a -5,000 USDT loss is officially retracted.
